title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: Introduces the Transformer architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms, with encoder and decoder stacks, multi-head self-attention, cross-attention, and positional encodings.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
abstract: Studies residual learning for very deep neural networks and introduces identity shortcut connections that make optimization of deeper models easier.

title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
abstract: Introduces jointly learned soft alignment and translation, allowing a decoder to focus on relevant source positions through additive attention.

title: Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer
abstract: Introduces sparsely gated mixture-of-experts layers with learned routing, top-k expert selection, and auxiliary load-balancing objectives.

title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
abstract: Presents a simplified sparse expert architecture that routes each token to one expert, improving the efficiency of large-scale Transformer training.

title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
abstract: Introduces selective state-space models whose parameters depend on the input and a hardware-aware scan implementation for efficient sequence modeling.

title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
abstract: Introduces SimCLR, a contrastive learning framework with stochastic data augmentation, an encoder, a projection head, and a normalized temperature-scaled contrastive loss.

title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
abstract: Presents DINO self-distillation for vision transformers using teacher and student networks, multi-crop views, and momentum updates.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
abstract: Introduces Vision Transformer, which represents an image as a sequence of patches and processes the sequence with a standard Transformer encoder.

title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
abstract: Introduces graph convolutional networks using localized first-order approximations of spectral graph convolutions for semi-supervised node classification.

title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
abstract: Trains image and text encoders on paired image-text data using a contrastive objective, enabling natural-language supervision and zero-shot transfer.

title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs
abstract: Introduces GraphSAGE, an inductive framework that learns node representations by sampling and aggregating features from local neighborhoods.

title: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
abstract: Introduces the structured state-space sequence model S4 and efficient parameterization for long-range sequence modeling.

title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
abstract: Presents the T5 text-to-text framework, unifying diverse NLP tasks through a common encoder-decoder Transformer formulation.

title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
abstract: Studies calibration of modern neural networks and introduces temperature scaling as a simple post-hoc calibration method, evaluated with reliability diagrams.

title: Accurate Uncertainties for Deep Learning Using Calibrated Regression
abstract: Introduces a calibration method for regression uncertainty estimates, using empirical coverage to assess whether predictive intervals match their nominal levels.
